verdict.rationale: Restate offers durable timers/sleep, concurrency/flow-control limits, and external event coordination, which could be composed to build debounce/batch/delay logic, but there is no documented built-in debounce, batching, or event-collapsing primitive for noisy streams. missing for 10: explicit debounce/batch/collapse API or pattern, documented example of collapsing duplicate/noisy triggers into a single run, independent evidence of this use case working in practice.
